mop_policy_evaluation.policy_title: Guidelines and Standards for Installation and Operation of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure - 2024
mop_policy_evaluation.issuing_authority: Ministry of Power, Government of India
mop_policy_evaluation.standard_clause: Clause 11(1)(a) — Urban 1km x 1km Grid Density Target (by FY 2029-30)
mop_policy_evaluation.mandate: At least 1 charging station within a 1 km x 1 km grid in urban areas by FY 2029-30 (FY 2030)
mop_policy_evaluation.compliance_verdict: PARTIALLY COMPLIANT — URBAN EXPANSION REQUIRED TO MEET FY2030 TARGET

summary.planning_benchmark: Ministry of Power Guidelines dated 17 Sept 2024 (Clause 11(1)(a))
summary.statutory_notice: Reflects an urban infrastructure target to be achieved progressively by FY 2029-30; cells lacking a charger represent planning investment priorities rather than immediate legal violations.
